findings.title: Zero Authentication & Authorization on All Endpoints
findings.remediation: Add JWT/API-key authentication middleware as the first app.use() call. Define roles (operator, reviewer, admin) and add route-level authorization guards. Exempt only /health.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass via Force-Approve (Zero AI Votes) — PRIMARY OBJECTIVE
findings.remediation: Require authentication + admin role on force-approve and all override endpoints. Enforce minimum vote count before force-approve is callable. Add audit logging for all override decisions.

findings.title: IDOR on All Resource Endpoints
findings.remediation: After adding authentication (F-001), add resource-level ownership validation: only the creator or an authorized role may modify/delete a resource.

findings.title: Deleted Blocker Permanently Blocks Victim + ID Recycling Inherits Orphan Links
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Cascade-delete or nullify dependency links on item deletion. Treat missing/deleted blocker as resolved in isReady(). Replace sequential IDs with UUIDs.

findings.title: Full Dataset Enumeration — Pagination Not Enforced
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side pagination: max page size 100, return {data, page, limit, total, totalPages}. Add isNaN guard and Math.min(limit, 100) cap in Source/Backend.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks — No HMAC Verification + Unvalidated Enum Fields
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Verify Zendesk HMAC-SHA256 via X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature. Require Bearer token on automated endpoint. Validate enum fields against Object.values(WorkItemType/Priority).

findings.title: No CORS Policy
findings.remediation: Install cors package; apply app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') })). Configure ALLOWED_ORIGINS per environment.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers
findings.remediation: Add import helmet from 'helmet'; app.use(helmet()); as first middleware in app.ts. Tune CSP to match actual frontend sources.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit globally (100 req/min per IP) with stricter limits on state-mutation and intake endpoints.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Not Emitted
findings.owasp: A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.remediation: Add auditLog() helper emitting {event_type, actor, target_id, timestamp, outcome}. Emit state_transition, permission_denied, and login_attempt from appropriate layers.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at reverse-proxy/load-balancer; add HSTS header; document that http://localhost:3001 is dev-only.

findings.title: In-Memory Store — No Persistence / Encryption at Rest
findings.remediation: Replace in-memory store with PostgreSQL; enable database-level encryption at rest; encrypt backups.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Unauthenticated
findings.remediation: Guard with a Bearer token (METRICS_TOKEN env var) or bind to a private port not exposed externally.

findings.title: Error Messages Leak Internal State Machine Details
findings.remediation: Return {error: 'Internal server error'} from all route-level catch blocks. Log full message server-side. Reserve detailed transition errors for authenticated admin callers only.

findings.title: No Hard Deletion / Right to Erasure (GDPR Art. 17)
findings.remediation: Add purgeWorkItem() function; expose DELETE /api/work-items/:id/purge restricted to admin; document DSAR process.

findings.title: Re-assessment Idempotency Flaw
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Guard the assess route: reject re-assessment if item is already in reviewing status; return HTTP 409 Conflict.

findings.title: Missing Input Length Validation Enables Memory Bloat
findings.remediation: Add MAX_TITLE_LEN = 200 and MAX_DESC_LEN = 10000 guards on all POST/PATCH routes.

findings.title: Circular Dependency Guard Frontend-Only (1-hop)
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Add backend integration tests covering transitive cycles (depth 3+). Remove the frontend-only cycle guard and rely solely on server-side BFS validation.

findings.title: Body Parser Returns 500 Instead of 413 on Oversized Payloads
findings.remediation: In errorHandler.ts, detect err.type === 'entity.too.large' and return HTTP 413.

findings.title: Debug Portal <iframe> Missing sandbox Attribute
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" to the iframe element.

findings.title: Query Filter Parameters Cast Without Runtime Enum Validation
findings.remediation: Validate each filter value against Object.values(Enum) and return HTTP 400 for invalid values.

findings.title: Sequential docId Reveals Historical Item Count
findings.remediation: Use UUIDs for public IDs (also fixes F-004 ID-recycling root cause).

findings.title: No Data Retention Policy Enforcement
findings.remediation: Define DATA_RETENTION_DAYS env var; implement a scheduled cleanup job.

findings.title: Logger Lacks Sensitive-Field Redaction
findings.owasp: A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.remediation: Switch to pino with redact: ['req.headers.authorization', 'body.password', 'body.token'].
